connectors.ubisoft.name: Ubisoft
connectors.ubisoft.errors.invalidId: This Ubisoft game has an invalid identifier and cannot be launched.
connectors.ubisoft.errors.launcherMissin: Ubisoft Connect was not found. Install it from ubisoft.com and try again.
connectors.ubisoft.errors.noCache: Install Ubisoft Connect and open it once to see your Ubisoft games here.
connectors.ubisoft.needsAutoDetection: Ubisoft Connect keeps its games in the Windows registry. To see them, turn on automatic detection.
connectors.ubisoft.login.title: Sign in to Ubisoft
connectors.ubisoft.login.body: A window with the official Ubisoft page will open. Sign in there, also with the verification code if it asks for one, and tick “Remember me”; the window closes by itself. Ludiary does not store your password.
connectors.ubisoft.error.login: Ubisoft did not accept the sign-in. Try again.
connectors.ubisoft.error.expired: You need to sign in to Ubisoft again.
connectors.ubisoft.disconnect.hint: Ludiary deletes its Ubisoft session from this computer. To sign out everywhere, change your password at ubisoft.com.
